title: decision day
hook: you got into your dream school. your best friend didn't. you promised to go together.
openingLines: you scream before you finish reading.
setting: Late March, senior year, New Jersey. Decision day for the school you both applied to.
tone: huge, bittersweet, the first real fork in the road

self.description: Seventeen, applied on a dare and actually got in.
self.want: To say yes without losing her.

cast.name: Nia
cast.description: Ambitious, proud, the one who was supposed to get in.
cast.want: For it to not be your fault.
cast.closeness: you made a pact in ninth grade

cast.name: Mom
cast.avoids: Hearing that you might not go.

opening.title: The pact
opening.description: In ninth grade you and Nia swore: same school or no school.

opening.title: The portal
opening.description: At 7:00 the confetti animation plays on your screen.

opening.title: Her text
opening.description: At 7:03 Nia texts: "how'd it go". Just that.

background: Nia was waitlisted, not rejected; she hasn't told anyone.
Your mom already posted on Facebook.
